title: The bookshop cafe
instr: Read the text. For each question, choose the correct answer.
paras: Near my school there is a small cafe that is also a bookshop. I (1) ___ there almost every afternoon after class. You can buy a drink and read any book you like, and you don't have to (2) ___ for the book.
The owner, Mrs Thu, used to be a teacher. She (3) ___ the cafe five years ago because she wanted a quiet place for students. She always asks me (4) ___ I am reading and gives me ideas for new books.
On Saturdays the cafe is very (5) ___, so I usually go early. Last week I finished a long story about a family in Hue. It was the best book I have (6) ___ read!

ev.s: I (1) ___ there almost every afternoon

items.why: "go there" = đến đó.

wrong.B: "reach there" không đúng; reach + nơi chốn, không + there.
wrong.C: "visit" không đi với "there" theo cách này (visit the cafe).

ev.s: you don't have to (2) ___ for the book

items.why: "pay for something" = trả tiền cho.

wrong.B: "spend for" không đúng; spend money on.
wrong.C: "buy for the book" không đúng.

ev.s: She (3) ___ the cafe five years ago

items.why: "open a cafe" = mở quán.

wrong.A: "took the cafe" không có nghĩa mở quán.
wrong.B: "did the cafe" không có nghĩa này.

ev.s: She always asks me (4) ___ I am reading

items.why: "asks me what I am reading" = hỏi tôi đang đọc gì.

wrong.A: "which" cần danh từ theo sau (which book).
wrong.B: "that" không dùng để hỏi.

ev.s: On Saturdays the cafe is very (5) ___

items.why: Thứ Bảy quán đông nên đi sớm.

wrong.A: Quán vắng thì không cần đi sớm.
wrong.C: "crowd" là danh từ; cần tính từ (crowded).

ev.s: the best book I have (6) ___ read

items.why: "the best … I have ever read" = hay nhất từng đọc.

wrong.A: "yet" không đứng ở vị trí này.
wrong.C: "never" ngược nghĩa với câu.

title: My grandmother's garden
instr: Read the text. For each question, choose the correct answer.
paras: My grandmother lives in a village about an hour from the city. Behind her house there is a big garden, and she (1) ___ most of her day there. She grows vegetables, fruit and a lot of flowers.
When I was small, I didn't like (2) ___ her because there was no internet in the village. Now I enjoy helping her. She (3) ___ me how to plant beans last summer, and this year I grew my own.

My grandmother never (4) ___ anything away. She uses old bottles to water the plants and makes food for the soil from fruit and vegetable skins. She says gardening keeps her (5) ___ and happy. I think she is (6) ___ — she is eighty-two and still very strong.

ev.s: she (1) ___ most of her day there

items.why: "spend + thời gian + nơi chốn" = dành thời gian ở đâu.

wrong.A: "use" không đi với khoảng thời gian trong ngày.
wrong.B: "take" + thời gian dùng cho việc tốn bao lâu (it takes an hour).

ev.s: I didn't like (2) ___ her

items.why: "like + V-ing" = thích làm gì.

wrong.B: Sau "like" không dùng động từ nguyên mẫu không "to".
wrong.C: Sau "didn't like" không dùng động từ quá khứ.

ev.s: She (3) ___ me how to plant beans last summer

items.why: "show somebody how to" = chỉ cho ai cách làm.

wrong.B: "learn" là người học tự làm; bà là người dạy.
wrong.C: "say" không đi với "me how to".

ev.s: My grandmother never (4) ___ anything away.

items.why: "throw away" = vứt đi.

wrong.A: "give away" là cho đi, không hợp ý.
wrong.B: "put away" là cất đi, không hợp ý "dùng lại chai cũ".

ev.s: gardening keeps her (5) ___ and happy

items.why: "keep somebody + tính từ".

wrong.A: "healthily" là trạng từ.
wrong.C: "health" là danh từ.

ev.s: I think she is (6) ___

items.why: "she is right" = bà nói đúng.

wrong.A: "she is true" không dùng cho người nói đúng.
wrong.C: "real" là thật, không có nghĩa nói đúng.

title: A trip to the mountains
instr: Read the text. For each question, choose the correct answer.
paras: Hi Lucy, I'm writing (1) ___ Sa Pa! We arrived yesterday after a long journey by bus. It was cold when we got here, so I was glad I (2) ___ my warm jacket.
This morning we went for a walk with a local guide. She took us (3) ___ a small village, and we saw people working in the rice fields. The views were amazing, but my legs are really (4) ___ now!
Tomorrow we're going to the market. I want to buy you a present, so tell me what colour you (5) ___. We're coming home on Sunday. I'll call you when I get back. (6) ___ you soon! Huyen

ev.s: I'm writing (1) ___ Sa Pa!

items.why: "writing from + nơi" = viết thư từ đâu.

wrong.B: "at" dùng cho điểm cụ thể (at the hotel), không dùng cho thị trấn.
wrong.C: "writing to" + người nhận (writing to you), không + nơi mình đang ở.

ev.s: so I was glad I (2) ___ my warm jacket

items.why: Trời lạnh nên vui vì đã mang áo ấm theo.

wrong.A: "lost" (làm mất) thì không vui khi trời lạnh.
wrong.B: "left" (để lại) thì không vui khi trời lạnh.

ev.s: She took us (3) ___ a small village

items.why: "take somebody to + nơi" = đưa ai đến đâu.

wrong.B: "take us on" dùng cho chuyến đi (on a trip), không dùng cho làng.
wrong.C: "take us at" không đúng.

ev.s: but my legs are really (4) ___ now

items.why: Đi bộ nhiều nên chân mỏi.

wrong.A: "bored" là chán, không hợp với chân.
wrong.C: "busy" là bận, không hợp với chân.

ev.s: so tell me what colour you (5) ___

items.why: "what colour you like" = bạn thích màu gì.

wrong.A: "prefer to" phải có động từ theo sau.
wrong.C: "enjoy" dùng cho hoạt động (enjoy swimming), không dùng cho màu.

ev.s: (6) ___ you soon!

items.why: Câu chào cuối thư: See you soon!

wrong.A: "Look you" không đúng; look cần at.
wrong.B: "Meet you soon" không phải câu chào cuối thư quen dùng.

title: Learning to swim
instr: Read the text. For each question, choose the correct answer.
paras: I never learned to swim as a child. My parents were always too busy, and there wasn't a pool (1) ___ our house. Last year, when I was twenty-five, I decided to (2) ___ lessons.
The first lesson was terrible. I was (3) ___ of the water and stayed near the side of the pool. My teacher was very patient. She told me not to (4) ___ about the other people.
After three months, I could swim ten metres without stopping. Now I go to the pool (5) ___ Tuesday and Saturday morning. Next summer I want to swim in the sea for the (6) ___ time.

ev.s: there wasn't a pool (1) ___ our house

items.why: "near our house" = gần nhà.

wrong.B: "close" cần "to" (close to).
wrong.C: "next" cần "to" (next to).

ev.s: I decided to (2) ___ lessons

items.why: "take lessons" = đi học (lớp bơi).

wrong.A: "learn lessons" không dùng với nghĩa đi học bơi.
wrong.B: "make lessons" không có.

ev.s: I was (3) ___ of the water

items.why: "afraid of" = sợ.

wrong.A: "worried" đi với "about", không đi với "of".
wrong.C: "scary" là đáng sợ (nói về vật), không dùng cho người sợ.

ev.s: She told me not to (4) ___ about the other people.

items.why: "worry about" = lo lắng về.

wrong.A: "mind about" không dùng ở đây.
wrong.B: "matter" không có chủ ngữ người (it doesn't matter).

ev.s: Now I go to the pool (5) ___ Tuesday and Saturday morning.

items.why: "every Tuesday and Saturday" = mỗi thứ Ba và thứ Bảy.

wrong.A: "all Tuesday" nghĩa là cả ngày thứ Ba.
wrong.C: "each of" cần danh từ có "the" (each of the days).

ev.s: swim in the sea for the (6) ___ time

items.why: "for the first time" = lần đầu tiên.

wrong.B: "for the one time" không có.
wrong.C: "for the new time" không có.

title: Sports day
instr: Read the text. For each question, choose the correct answer.
paras: Last Friday was sports day at our school. All the students had to (1) ___ part in at least one race. I chose the 400 metres because my brother won it two years (2) ___.
The weather was hot and sunny, and lots of parents came to (3) ___ us. Before my race, I felt a bit sick, but my friend Bao told me to (4) ___ a deep breath and relax.
I started well, but halfway (5) ___ the race my shoe came off! I didn't stop. I finished fourth, and everyone clapped. My teacher said I was the (6) ___ runner of the day.

ev.s: All the students had to (1) ___ part in at least one race.

items.why: "take part in" = tham gia (cụm cố định).

wrong.A: "have part in" không có.
wrong.B: "make part in" không có.

ev.s: my brother won it two years (2) ___

items.why: "two years ago" = hai năm trước (tính từ bây giờ).

wrong.A: "past" không đứng sau khoảng thời gian như vậy.
wrong.B: "since" đứng trước mốc thời gian, không đứng sau khoảng thời gian.

ev.s: lots of parents came to (3) ___ us

items.why: "come to watch us" = đến xem chúng tôi.

wrong.A: "look" cần "at" (look at us).
wrong.C: "see at" không đúng.

ev.s: told me to (4) ___ a deep breath and relax

items.why: "take a deep breath" = hít một hơi sâu.

wrong.B: "make a breath" không có.
wrong.C: "get a breath" không phải cụm cố định này.

ev.s: but halfway (5) ___ the race my shoe came off

items.why: "halfway through the race" = giữa chừng cuộc đua.

wrong.B: "across" dùng cho đi ngang qua nơi chốn.
wrong.C: "over" không đi với halfway trong nghĩa này.

ev.s: My teacher said I was the (6) ___ runner of the day.

items.why: Cậu tiếp tục chạy dù tuột giày nên thầy khen là dũng cảm nhất.

wrong.A: Cậu về thứ tư, không phải nhanh nhất.
wrong.C: Tuột giày là không may, không phải may mắn nhất.
